categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Green Pine Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the cosmetics industry, focusing on the design, research, and manufacturing of face masks, skincare products, wet wipes, and non-woven fabric products. Its main business is conducted through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Nosbell, which is one of the largest domestic ODM cosmetics manufacturers in China. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including face masks, skincare series, wet wipes, and other related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as microemulsion, liquid-oil instant emulsification, freeze-drying chip technology, electrospinning technology, and BFS blow-fill-seal production lines. It has a strong R&D team with over 180 professionals and holds 124 patents, including 61 invention patents. The production process integrates design, formulation, packaging, and quality control, supported by certifications like ISO9001, ISO13485, cGMP, and Halal certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include international and domestic well-known cosmetics brands such as Unilever, Procter & Gamble, Estée Lauder, Sephora, Watsons, Shiseido, Nivea, and local brands like Shanghai Jahwa, Herborist, Proya, and Miniso. It also serves emerging e-commerce brands and social commerce platforms. The end markets are primarily cosmetics brand companies that distribute products through online e-commerce platforms, social media, specialty stores, supermarkets, and beauty salons.
categories.geographic_coverage: Fujian Green Pine operates mainly in China with significant sales in regions including East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northeast China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. It also has a notable export business, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 18.41% of total revenue, serving markets in Europe and other international regions. The company has subsidiaries and operations in Guangdong, Zhejiang, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the cosmetics supply chain as an ODM manufacturer, providing integrated design, R&D, and manufacturing services for cosmetics brands. It sources raw materials such as chemical ingredients, non-woven fabrics, and packaging materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to downstream brand owners and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and digital transformation, focusing on sustainable development and industry-leading R&D capabilities. It collaborates with universities and research institutes on raw material innovation, formulation optimization, and process improvement. Key R&D projects include plant-based active ingredients, electrospun fiber membranes, micro-nano encapsulation technologies, and advanced skin efficacy evaluation systems. The company also invests in digital factory upgrades to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ODM cosmetic products to brand customers based on confirmed orders. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, designing and manufacturing products according to client specifications and selling finished goods under clients' brands. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fujian Green Pine, through its subsidiary Nosbell, is positioned as one of the largest and leading domestic cosmetics ODM manufacturers in China. It competes with other ODM/OEM cosmetics manufacturers by leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, extensive client base including top international and domestic brands, advanced manufacturing technologies, and comprehensive quality management systems. The company has received numerous industry awards and recognitions, reinforcing its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.94 billion, a slight decrease of 1.51% compared to 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 54.68 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in the previous year. The company maintains substantial total assets of over RMB 2.1 billion and net assets of approximately RMB 1.3 billion. It has a professional R&D team and continues to invest in capacity expansion and digital transformation to support sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering integrated ODM services with strong technological innovation, high-quality product formulations, and advanced manufacturing capabilities. It provides customized, high-efficacy cosmetic solutions supported by extensive patent portfolios and scientific efficacy testing. Its commitment to quality, compliance with international standards, and ability to rapidly respond to diverse client needs create significant value for brand customers seeking reliable, innovative, and scalable manufacturing partners.
